verdict.rationale: Cerebras ships official first-party SDKs: a Python package installed with `pip install --upgrade cerebras_cloud_sdk` in the quickstart, and a TypeScript/JavaScript library in the Cerebras GitHub org. The Node SDK also includes SDK-specific behaviour such as TCP warming to reduce time-to-first-token, and OpenAI compatibility further eases building against it. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation beyond quickstart and README snippets, evidence of SDKs for other languages, independent hands-on corroboration of the official SDKs, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Cerebras REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
This SDK has a mechanism that sends a few requests to `/v1/tcp_warming` upon construction to reduce the TTFT.
